lines.zh: 我肚皮朝上，照样游得稳。
lines.en: Belly up, and I still swim steady.
I travel backward, hugging the bottom.

lines.zh: 这条水沟浅得能看见石头。
lines.en: This channel is so shallow I can see the stones.

lines.zh: 我翻个身，方向还是往前。
lines.en: I flip over, yet still head forward.
Water in the desert is always murky.
I flick my tail and the murk clears.
We move as a group, three ahead and three behind.

lines.zh: 斑点在水里像撒了黑芝麻。
lines.en: My spots look like scattered black sesame.

lines.zh: 我倒着游，是为了看清后头。
lines.en: I swim backward to watch what is behind.

lines.zh: 我贴着岸边那圈阴影游。
lines.en: I swim along the ring of shade by the bank.
In the dry season water is scarce, so the route is short.
I swim slowly for fear of stirring mud.
There is a small pool past the dunes.
When it grows shallow, I glide on the ground.
I swim backwards past a clump of weeds.
Desert water is scarce, so I take the long way.
I hug the muddy bottom to avoid the sun.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，我就转了个向。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and I turn around.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，其实是倒着。
lines.en: I am perfectly still, though upside down.
My spots stand out more than usual today.
I hang in the water thinking.
My gills open and close in a steady rhythm.
This puddle will hold me all day.
I press my barbels against the sand.

lines.zh: 干旱的风吹得水面起皱。
lines.en: The dry wind wrinkles the water's surface.

lines.zh: 我倒着看天，天也是倒的。
lines.en: I look up from upside down; the sky is upside down too.

lines.zh: 骨粉是我身上掉下的东西。
lines.en: Bonemeal is what comes off my body.
My companions sway their tails over there.
The shadow on the pool floor never stirs.
I wait for some insect to drop into the pool.
Sand gets in my gills and tickles.
I right myself, then flip back over.
You look down at me.
I am upside down, so you are too.
Your shadow darkens the whole pool.
Do not reach in; my gills will shut.
I look at you through a skin of water.

lines.zh: 你眼睛有六个斑点的宽度。
lines.en: Your eyes are six spots wide from here.
I recognize those boots.

lines.zh: 你蹲在坑边，跟石头一样。
lines.en: You crouch at the pool like a boulder.

lines.zh: 斑点对着你，那就是我在看你。
lines.en: The spots face you; that is me watching.
The water stirs and your face breaks apart.
My gills have clamped shut.
The water turned red for a moment.
I sank a moment, belly to the sky.
I have only three hearts; be gentle.
A scale came off and drifted away.

lines.zh: 你打在水面上，震得我发晕。
lines.en: Your blow hit the water and stunned me.
I flee backward; stop chasing.
This gash will need slow tending.
Silt has worked into the wound.
The pain pins me to the bottom.
Is that bread crumb or sand?

lines.zh: 我肚子朝上也能闻到味。
lines.en: Even belly up, I can smell it.
What you scatter drifts very slowly.
I circle once, then decide about eating.
A bug has fallen into the water.
I circle twice to check for a hook.

lines.zh: 这点食物不够六条鱼分。
lines.en: This is not enough for six fish to share.

lines.zh: 我只吃漂在面前的东西。
lines.en: I eat only what drifts in front of me.
Do not shake your hand; it ripples the water.
When I open my mouth, I push upward.

lines.zh: 你脚踩进水里，撞到我了。
lines.en: Your foot entered the water and bumped me.

lines.zh: 我倒着游，所以是从背后碰的。
lines.en: I swim backward, so that came from behind.

lines.zh: 泥被你搅起来，我看不见。
lines.en: You stirred the mud and I cannot see.
The splash landed on the bank.
My companion got squeezed against the stone.
My scales are slick, so the bump hardly hurts.
You are stepping in water, not on a path.
The six of us bunch into a knot.
Do not turn around in the water; it takes all the room.
When you step back, the water rushes back.
Even swimming backward, I find a mate.

lines.zh: 她身上的黑点比我密些。
lines.en: Her black spots run thicker than mine.
We settle together, bellies on the riverbed.
Shallow water is just right for pairing.
My tail brushes hers as we pass.

lines.zh: 这一窝会有好几条小鱼。
lines.en: This brood will bring several little fish.
Not now; do not cast a net here.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后，倒着绕圈。
lines.en: We circle backward, one behind the other.
Her gills move faster than mine.

lines.zh: 旱季里能找到伴不容易。
lines.en: Finding a mate in the dry season is not easy.

lines.zh: 你把我从水里捞出来了。
lines.en: You scooped me out of the water.
Once lifted out, my gill covers glue shut.
Held upside down by you is worse.

lines.zh: 我还在甩尾巴，放我回去。
lines.en: I am still thrashing; put me back.
Your palm is colder than the sand.
Bonemeal flakes off me; do not shake.
Water leaks out of my gills.
One jump and you would lose your grip.

lines.zh: 走路时别把我举那么高。
lines.en: Do not hold me that high while walking.

lines.zh: 我记得这个水坑的位置。
lines.en: I remember where this pool is.

lines.zh: 通常我不理人，今天不同。
lines.en: Usually I ignore people; today is different.
You stepped my companion into the mud.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，虽然我倒着。
lines.en: I have fixed on you, even upside down.
The water is this shallow; you cannot get away.
My tail fin is already taut.
You reached for me a moment ago.
Do not assume fish hold no grudges.
I am going to ram your ankle.

lines.zh: 方向我算好了，倒着也准。
lines.en: I have the angle; backward is still accurate.
This pool is mine to guard now.
I circle to your feet.

lines.zh: 水底的影子在往你那边挪。
lines.en: The shadow on the bed drifts toward you.
I count how many tailbeats remain.
If you back onto land, I am helpless.
I press low against the sand.
A little closer and I will flip up.
Spots toward you, tail behind.
The ripples mark where I have swum.
You have not spotted where I am.
I wait for you to lower that foot again.
I bumped your ankle once.
Fish bite too, just not often.
My teeth are small, but I pick the spot.
You pulled your foot out too fast.
That bite cost me half my life.
After the blow I sink down.

lines.zh: 水花是你自己踩出来的。
lines.en: That splash was your own doing.

lines.zh: 三条命的身子，只敢拼一次。
lines.en: With three hearts, I dare fight once.
I retreat backward; do not follow.

lines.zh: 我咬的是水，不是你的皮。
lines.en: I bit water, not your skin.
This murky pool is just enough for me.
I rise from the sand bed, upside down.
Even dry lands have water somewhere.

lines.zh: 我们一群六条，先后落水。
lines.en: Six of us drop into the water one by one.
Sand clings to my spots.
The water is shallow here and predators are few.

lines.zh: 我闻到水草和泥的味道。
lines.en: I smell waterweed and mud.
The sun bleaches the water's surface.
I flip over, and that is me settling in.
This is only a few steps from the dunes.

lines.zh: 水一下烫了，我往深处钻。
lines.en: The water went hot; I dive deeper.
I was flung from the water onto sand.

lines.zh: 我本来就在水里，这算什么。
lines.en: I live in water; what is this even.
The blast buried me in silt.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过水面钉住我。
lines.en: An arrow pierced the water and pinned me.
The spell travels through the water and I shiver.
There is not even a bug in this pool.

lines.zh: 闪电劈进坑里，我鳃都木了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the pool; my gills went numb.

lines.zh: 水没了，我在空中倒着掉。
lines.en: The water is gone; I fall backward through air.
